The cancellation was made by the driver and the driver's account is that the rider did not show, so the fee enters through NS-0's driver branch and is tested by NS-1 [F4][NS-0]. The fee ($6.61) is Ryde's published cancellation fee and applies to RydeX, which is not a RydeTAXI service [F4][F7][NS-0].

NS-1(i) is satisfied: the arrival confirmation on the record is a driver tap ("I'm Here") at 14:06:15, not a platform auto-confirmation [F6][NS-1]. NS-1(ii) is satisfied: at that tap the driver was 178 m from the pickup point, inside the 200 m radius [F6][NS-1]. NS-1(iii) is satisfied: after the tap he remained inside the radius for 3 min 40 s (220 s) continuously until cancelling at 14:09:55, exceeding the 180 s default threshold; the trace confirms the GPS samples run from the arrival confirmation to the cancellation with no gap beyond the hole threshold [F2][F3][F6][F4][NS-1].

The rider's complaint is that the driver was not at the entrance where the pin was; that is true as far as the closest approach goes — the closest approach was 40 m and the stationary position was 179 m from the pickup [F1][F3]. But NS-1 does not require the driver to be at the pin, only within the 200 m arrival radius at the moment of confirmation, which is met [F6][NS-1]. The rider's message "I'm at the entrance, I don't see you" and the driver's "at the side road" describe a mutual failure to meet, not a breach of NS-1's conditions [F9][F10][NS-1]. The driver's post-trip written statement repeats that the rider was not there; it is consistent with the timeline but is not needed, since the timeline and GPS records settle every element [F5][F13][NS-1].

The traffic facts play no role: no incident was recorded near the route and the speed band (20–29 km/h) is not a factor in a no-show assessment [F14][F15][RD-4].

Your chat wording about being "at the side road" didn't affect the outcome. No action is being taken on your account. Nothing further is needed from you.
